summary.text: Ann Moloney is the Republican candidate for Missouri House of Representatives District 114 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Jessie Shepherd.
Moloney won the August 4, 2026 Republican primary over David Broach, 2,484 votes to 2,327, and had also run in the 2022 Republican primary for the seat, which Ken Waller won.
